arc.fallback: Tarkus and the Dark Knight Bruford

description.fallback: Bruford manages to escape Jonathan's Ripple by backflipping onto land and receives only a scratch. The knight tells Jonathan that he wishes to fight him on equal grounds, without handicaps, because he thinks Jonathan has the skill of a hero. Jonathan in turn notes Bruford's demonstration of his chivalry and pride.

text.fallback: Head out: Tarkus and the Dark Knight Bruford, Part 4

outro.fallback: The weapon conducts Jonathan's Metal Silver Overdrive and transfers the Ripple power into Bruford's right arm causing it to melt off.
While Bruford is still stunned, Jonathan uses the Sunlight Yellow Overdrive to deliver consecutive blows to his opponent.
